phase2_full_field_warehouse.note: A generic point-in-time R1-participation warehouse could be built directly from HISTORICAL_R1_GROUPING_EVIDENCE_BLOCKER_RESOLUTION_V1.json (game_code, player_id, player_name, starting_tee, tee_time, field_size=player_count, source=official grouping page, source_sha256=response_sha256 per record) -- but per Phase 1's minimum-fields requirement (r1_score, r1_to_par, r1_rank, r1_status), the performance fields cannot be populated for any player, cut-survivor or not, from this source. Building this warehouse without the score fields would not move Phase 4 (model reopening) forward, since the R1 MODEL's entire purpose is to condition on R1 PERFORMANCE, not merely R1 attendance. It was therefore not materialized as a separate file in this task -- doing so would be busywork without unblocking anything downstream, and this artifact records the exact reusable join key/fields instead so it is not lost.

phase3_survivor_bias_gate.verdict: SG-based survivor bias is UNCHANGED (historical_sg_warehouse.json itself was correctly left unmodified -- fabricating scores into it would violate the no-invented-values rule). The NEW grouping source removes participation-level survivor bias but cannot remove performance-level survivor bias, because it carries no performance field at all. The gate this phase asks to re-run (R1-SG-match-rate by cut outcome) is therefore unchanged and remains disqualifying for CUT-tier modeling.

phase4_10_status: NOT REOPENED. Reopening the frozen research protocol (candidate specification, walk-forward, calibration, freeze) requires a full-field R1 PERFORMANCE feature, which Phase 1-3 above establish is still not recoverable in this sandbox -- from either existing archives (exhaustively checked) or live re-collection (network-blocked, freshly re-verified, not merely assumed). Proceeding to Phase 4 would require either (a) inventing R1 performance values for the ~97.8% of historical cut-missers who lack them -- explicitly forbidden by this task's own Phase 5 rule against fabricated updates and by the original research task's section 5 leakage rules -- or (b) restricting the model to the cut-survivor sub-population only, which was already identified and deliberately not pursued in KB_2026090003_R1_MODEL_V1_RESEARCH_V1.json because it answers a different question than the one KB's application needs and breaks the required CUT-anchored probability coherence stack.

final_status_detail.what_changed_since_800870b: A real, unbiased, 82/82-tournament full-field R1 PARTICIPATION source was found and verified (HISTORICAL_R1_GROUPING_EVIDENCE_BLOCKER_RESOLUTION_V1.json, backed by 82 archived official HTML captures) -- this directly answers the owner's Phase 1 trace request and is a genuine partial recovery, not a repeat of the prior finding.
final_status_detail.what_did_not_change: Full-field R1 PERFORMANCE (scores) remains unrecoverable: no archived source contains it, the sqlite corpus is absent, and live re-collection from klpga.co.kr is network-blocked (freshly re-verified via direct curl against two endpoints, both 403 at the proxy layer).
